themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and interact with systems to achieve research goals.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools and techniques that assist developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles discussing various AI-powered tools and platforms designed to aid in the research process, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Explores how AI is changing the job market, affecting employment, and necessitating new skills and strategies for the workforce.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of artificial users or data to simulate real user behavior for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare the capabilities and effectiveness of different AI tools for research purposes.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Features AI-driven platforms designed for scientific research, data analysis, and knowledge discovery.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Covers AI techniques and tools that condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Details how AI can be applied to various aspects of product management, including research, development, and strategy.

themes.name: AI research tools broad
